name: cublas_cublasStrsm_v2
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench cuBLAS test_cublasStrsm_v2.py. Single-precision triangular solve op(A) X = alpha*B (side=LEFT=0) via the real cuBLAS baseline; B is overwritten with X and returned. The test builds a well-conditioned A by adding 5.0 to the diagonal, replicated here in gen_inputs (a full matrix with a boosted diagonal; cuBLAS references only the uplo/diag-selected triangle, so it is well-conditioned for either uplo). B is a random (m,n) tensor. side/uplo/trans/diag are ints exactly as the test passes them; representative uplo/trans/diag combinations are covered across the rows. Requires kernelgenbench + cuBLAS at eval time.
